board.name: boolean_xc7s50
board.notes: Real Digital Boolean, xc7s50csga324-1: N=8 INT8, BUFFER_SIZE=32768, WEIGHT_REGION_WORDS=27648, PROG_DEPTH=32768, MAX_BATCH_COUNT=4. Existing Artix sweeps show 33 BRAM36 at PROG_DEPTH=32768/BUFFER_SIZE=4096; memory-bit extrapolation estimates about 46/75 BRAM36 (29-tile margin) for this point. Estimate only; Boolean synthesis is required for measured fit.

selection_rule: first 10 test-set examples with at least 6 of 10 logits not equal to INT8 clip endpoints
